transcript: Today was an interesting day in the aspects of InPublic. I really understood what I was doing for once on the I was trying to grow an audience and I was doing the follow back follow method where we was gonna follow each other, where I had to follow people, and I had to just follow them back at the same time. But one of the main things I was encountering I was encountering the x time I was with I was being timed out ever so often, and people were like, follow me back, bro. Follow me back, bro. And it was really interesting. It was the first time I really grew from 60 followers to about 400 and something. And was one of the most times I actually enjoyed when I was grinding in that sense. But I today also today, I challenged someone and I was like, I didn't know you were willing to add me the best for the win, and I was kinda shocked because I didn't know he was just it's our prototype, bro. And I was like, he surrendering. In my head, I was like, he surrender. One time, I was like, no. I'm embarrassed. Like, he was so weak. I was like, was going to my mind, but I didn't really say that, but that's what I was thinking. But that's just what happened today. Today was a really nice day. Compared to yesterday, today was a much better day. I I accomplished a lot, and I'm moving forward.
